subject: Pricing structure and technical scoping for observability add-ons (retention, tracing, dashboards)
messages:
From: Maya Rios <maya@aperturehealth.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: procure@aperturehealth.com
Date: 2026-08-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Clarify add-on pricing for retention/tracing/dashboards

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the dashboards looked like a good fit for our ops team. Procurement asked me to pull together the exact commercial ask so they can evaluate internally. A few specific questions they want answered before we escalate: 

- Can you split the add-on pricing between (a) long-term retention (30/90/365 day buckets), (b) distributed tracing (sample rates, span storage), and (c) advanced dashboards (seat vs. per-dashboard compute)?
- What discounts do you offer if we commit to a 12-month addon term vs. a pilot? Any crediting approach for initial overages during ramp?
- Are there hard limits or expected cost drivers we should budget for (eg. trace egress, dashboard query compute)?

If you can send a single-sheet breakdown and an updated proposal we can share with procurement, that would be ideal.

Appreciate it — aim to have an internal decision by end of next week.

Best,
Maya
Director, Platform Engineering
Aperture Health

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Maya Rios <maya@aperturehealth.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-12T11:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify add-on pricing for retention/tracing/dashboards

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear list. Sending an initial breakdown attached (Aperture_Proposal_v2.pdf) and a quick summary below to answer procurement's bullets. Happy to hop on a short call if they want to walk the numbers.

Summary (high level):
- Retention: three buckets priced per GB-month. 30/90/365 priced at $0.12 / $0.08 / $0.03 per GB-month respectively. Includes KV prefix caching for read-heavy queries.
- Tracing: priced by retained span-volume + sample-rate tiers. Base tier (up to 100M spans/mo) $2,500/mo. Additional spans billed at $0.000025/span. We recommend a 10-20% sampling rate for service A to balance signal vs. cost; product team confirmed trace indexing is the primary cost driver.
- Advanced dashboards: charged as a combo of seat licenses + compute pool. Seats include dashboard editing/view-only; compute pool billed separately for high-cardinality queries. Example: 10 seats + 50 compute-hours/month = $1,200/mo.

Discounting / credits:
- 12-month committed addon: 8% standard discount on the add-on subtotal.
- 12-month + 3x usage commit (total platform + addons): up to 15% phased discount — needs AE approval.
- Ramp credits: we can provide a one-time 1-month usage credit per addon during the first billing cycle for pilots under 3 months.

I've also included a simple bucket spreadsheet (retention-bucket-breakdown.xlsx) inside the PDF for modeling. Next steps: if procurement is OK with the structure, Jordan can work quotes and concessioning; we can then issue an updated SOW/DocuSign.

Attachments: Aperture_Proposal_v2.pdf (proposal + SKU table)

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Lead, Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-13T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Aperture pricing — concession ask and technical confirm

Laura / Jordan — forwarding Aperture's ask (thread above). Two things:

1) Concession ask: Maya called out wanting a clearer crediting path and a stronger discount if they roll addons into a 12-month commit. They are mid-market but health vertical — some procurement friction expected. Can we offer a 10% addon discount if they commit to 12 months for addons only (not full platform) and agree to a 30% annual ramp minimum?

2) Technical confirm: Product needs to confirm whether our retention buckets (30/90/365) include automated archival pricing or if that is billed separately as egress + archival requests. Stephanie — can you confirm the billing model (archival vs in-place retention) and any practical sample-rate guidance for traces so we can model budget scenarios?

If we can land the 10% concession above, I think the deal gets to a commercial review quickly.

—Ben
Senior Sales Manager

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-13T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Aperture pricing — concession ask and technical confirm

Ben / team — quick product note on the technical constraints and suggested language for pricing: 

- Retention model: we store recent hot data in tiered SSD-backed nodes and automatically archive 90+ day material to cold object storage. Pricing split recommended: in-place retention up to 90d (per GB-month), archival retrieval and egress billed separately for >90d reads. For quoting purposes use the per-GB-month rates Laura listed and add an "archival retrieval" line at $0.10/GB on read.
- Tracing: span ingestion cost is primarily indexing. For customers that need full-fidelity traces we suggest an indexing plan + raw span storage option (higher cost). For most workloads we recommend dynamic sampling: start at 20% across services and increase to 50% for critical paths (payment, auth). Provide two SKU options: "Standard Tracing" (sample-based, lower cost) and "Indexed Tracing" (higher cost, full index).
- Dashboards: compute pool is the cost driver for ad-hoc high-cardinality queries. Recommend a burst cap (e.g., 200 compute-hours) to prevent runaway costs, with alerts and auto-throttling. Seats are straightforward — list seat price and include an option to add managed dashboards (one-time setup).

Commercial guidance: 10% addon discount for 12-month addon-only commits is acceptable for AE-level approval. Anything >12% requires RevOps sign-off. Ramp credit: we can formalize a 1-month credit per addon for pilots <90 days (non-stackable).

I'll prepare a brief FAQ snippet we can attach to the SOW describing "what drives cost" (sample rate, retention bucket, query compute) and suggested guardrails (burst caps, alerts, default sampling).

—Steph
Product Manager, Observability

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Maya Rios <maya@aperturehealth.com>, Procure Team <procure@aperturehealth.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-15T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Updated commercial + next steps (Aperture Health)

Hi Maya / Procurement team — following up with an updated offer and next steps. Below is the consolidated commercial that reflects product constraints and the concession we can make for a 12-month addon commit. See attached proposal for line-item math (Aperture_Proposal_v2.pdf).

Offer (consolidated):
- Retention buckets (per GB-month): 30d = $0.12, 90d = $0.08, 365d = $0.03. Archival retrieval (reads from cold storage) = $0.10/GB.
- Tracing: Standard Tracing base up to 100M spans/mo = $2,500/mo; additional spans $0.000025/span. Indexed Tracing available as optional upgrade — pricing on request. Recommended initial sample plan: 20% baseline with critical paths at 50%.
- Advanced Dashboards: 10 seats + 50 compute-hours = $1,200/mo (example). We will include a configurable burst cap with alerts.

Discounts / Credits:
- 12-month addon-only commit: 10% off the addon subtotal (applies to retention + tracing + dashboards).
- Ramp credit: one-time 1-month usage credit per addon during the first billing cycle for pilots under 90 days.

Guardrails / Technical notes:
- Archival reads billed separately (see line item).
- We will set default sampling at 20% across services and provide instrumentation guides.
- Dashboard compute caps and alerting will be enabled by default.

Next steps:
1) If the commercial is OK, Jordan will generate a formal quote in HubSpot and we will route to your procurement team. HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/ACME-CRM/record/DEAL-8471
2) We can put the concession in the SOW and send via DocuSign (preview link: https://www.docusign.com/sign/DocuSignLink-8471).
3) Optional: 30-minute technical walkthrough with our Product/Dev team to finalize sample plans and burst caps.

Please let me know if you want any changes to the bucket sizes or discount structure. If procurement is comfortable, I'll ask Jordan to push the quote to DocuSign tomorrow.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Account Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Aperture_Proposal_v2.pdf; retention-bucket-breakdown.xlsx
